verified_facts.text: The hotel is one minute away from Piazza San Marco.
verified_facts.excerpt: just one minute away from Piazza San Marco

verified_facts.text: The Marco Polo Ballroom is surrounded by original 18th-century frescoes.
verified_facts.excerpt: in the splendid Marco Polo Ballroom, surrounded by original 18th-century frescoes

verified_facts.text: Superior Rooms have original period furniture and original Murano chandeliers.
verified_facts.excerpt: Original Venetian Style, original period furniture, original Murano chandeliers.

verified_facts.text: Canal View Rooms look onto a side canal and the Royal Gardens, with gondolas passing below.
verified_facts.excerpt: these rooms allow you to gaze down at the gondolas floating by, as well as the Royal Gardens.

verified_facts.text: The Giorgione Terrace Suite has an Altana, a raised wooden terrace overlooking the roofs of the city.
verified_facts.excerpt: You’ll also love the Altana, a raised wooden terrace overlooking the roofs of the city.

verified_facts.text: Lagoon-view suites look over the San Marco Basin and San Giorgio Island.
verified_facts.excerpt: this Junior Suite offers maximum comfort and a splendid view of the San Marco Basin & San Giorgio Island.

verified_facts.text: The San Giorgio Terrace Suite 2-Bedroom has the hotel's largest terrace, with views of San Giorgio Island.
verified_facts.excerpt: Open the doors to our largest hotel terrace, which offers breathtaking views of San Giorgio Island.

verified_facts.text: The Goldoni Family Suite has a separate living area and two bedrooms.
verified_facts.excerpt: this Suite consists of a separate living area and two elegant bedrooms, one with a king-size bed and the other with a French bed.

verified_facts.text: Superior Rooms include Acqua di Parma bathroom amenities.
Santo Mare serves Italian seafood in a fishmonger-inspired setting.
verified_facts.excerpt: Taste the finest in Italian seafood—showcasing the freshest catches, paired with Italian mastery, in a stylish fishmonger-inspired setting.

verified_facts.text: The Canova Bar serves espresso, aperitivo and cocktails, plus a selection of light fare.
verified_facts.excerpt: Whether you’re seeking an espresso, pre-dinner aperitivo, or an original cocktail, Canova Bar will delight the sophisticated palate.

verified_facts.text: The hotel's experiences include a VIP after-hours Doge's Palace tour.
